what_was_adopted: Category-enumeration method: enumerate every coding agent, then check each, because a string search misses products and false-positives on the word 'continue'. Data: agents-universe.csv enumeration, models.dev registry cost tables, relay-market snapshots. Tooling patterns (batch first-party fetchers, snapshot layout).
where_it_landed: data/agents-universe.csv (30 agents, 18 absent from all prior sources, 2 rows added by this pass); data/modelsdev-providers.csv and data/cheapest-per-model.csv (re-based on a fresh 222-provider / 7,869-model registry pull); tools/fetch-firstparty.py re-implemented without the reverse-proxy dependency; sources/commandcode-pricing-fork-snapshot.txt
independent_verification: The models.dev registry was re-pulled first-party on 2026-09-20 and the counts re-derived independently (222 providers / 7,869 models). The agents-universe and method were re-checked against first-party pricing pages for every plan they sourced.
scope_exclusion: Excluded from rankings: its relay/sponsor tables and any reachability figure measured through a third-party reverse proxy. Its relay snapshots are retained as evidence for the advisory, not as a market ranking. Its CNY-denominated prices were not adopted unconverted.
